title: TipsInteractionListResult
description: tips.interaction-list-result@1: answers of tips.interaction.list on OpenVibe.Tips. GET /api/v1/interactions?creator=&supporter=&include_test=&cursor=&limit= → { interactions, next_cursor }: newest first, at most 200 a page (50 by default); a service names a creator or a supporter (422 tips.invalid_input otherwise); a person gets their own receipts, or with ?as=creator the tips they received. include_test=0 leaves simulations out. GET /api/v1/profiles/:creator/totals → { creator, totals }: derived from settled interactions; settled_via_billing is what must equal Billing's books (minus what Billing took back), external and simulations are reported apart.

settled_via_billing.description: Bits settled through Billing (or imported from Live's ledger), less reversals.

external.description: Bits of EXTERNAL tips (the creator's own PowerChat): no Billing liability.

interactions.description: Settled or reversed interactions, simulations excluded.
